topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't help but replay the events leading up to the car being towed from my driveway. I should have noticed the warning signs, like the expired registration sticker I kept meaning to replace. Now, standing here, the empty spot where my car once was feels like a constant reminder of my oversight. I called the towing company, my voice almost apologetic as I asked about the whereabouts and the cost to retrieve it. I've made mental notes to double-check everything before this ever happens again. It’s a lesson learned, one that’s going to cost me more than just the towing fee.
